data.body: Change 3527 merged as c8118c62e81 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved, submitted 17:26 PST). cli-main fast-forwarded to c8118c62e81 (no local commits, version 0.16.0 unchanged, editable install). SANDBOXED review-plan (Claude Code Bash sandbox, allowed_domains api.anthropic.com only, 17:26-17:36 PST, log .rebar/scratch/bluewhale-05f74084/review-plan-sandboxed.log): real signed verdict BLOCK, model anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5, verified_at_sha c8118c62e81, 0 indeterminate, no connection errors - every LLM call reached the API through the sandbox proxy (before the fix the same command returned INDETERMINATE with gaierror 8). The 1 blocking finding (E4) targets the plan text: the Root-cause bullet says the gate always targets https://api.anthropic.com, which is false for endpoint overrides, REBAR_LLM_ALLOW_LOCAL_PROXY, non-loopback gateways and local OpenAI-compatible servers, and the plan did not specify the loopback rule. The merged code already sends loopback hosts direct with tests (test_loopback_hosts_connect_directly_without_no_proxy, test_openai_compatible_local_server_connects_directly_without_no_proxy); correcting the description to match, acceptance criteria untouched, then re-reviewing.
